factual_profile.free_plan_status: No permanent free plan; 14-day free trial

best_for: Teams that need segmentation and CRM/ecommerce integrations
not_recommended_for: Users who need a permanently free email marketing plan
Very small senders who do not need advanced automation
editorial.editorial_summary: ActiveCampaign combines email marketing, marketing automation and CRM-related workflows. Its visual automation builder and segmentation are useful for teams coordinating campaigns across customer stages. It is less suitable if a permanent free plan or a simple one-off newsletter sender is the main requirement.

pricing.trial: 14 days; trial supports up to 100 email sends and one user
pricing.billingCaveat: The official pricing page asks visitors to configure contacts and currency or request tailored pricing; do not rely on legacy fixed prices. Confirm the quote on the official site.
conflicts: Legacy migrated prices of $19/$59/$99 are not confirmed on the current official pricing page.

changeLog.change: Removed legacy fixed prices and incorrect free-plan claim after checking official pricing and trial pages.
